'''Bulk blocks''' are packed stacks of building blocks sold by the [[Mason]]. Each one unpacks into 64 of its block when used. One [[Obol]] buys between 64 and 384 blocks this way.

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
Bulk blocks are only sold by the [[Mason]], which has no other trades. All trades cost 1 obol:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/villager_trade/mason/custom_level_1.json}}</ref>

''Names in italics'' are descriptive: these six bulk blocks have no name in the language file, so in game they show their raw translation keys (for example <code>item.kleispack.trade.bulk_terracotta</code>). See [[#Issues|Issues]].

== Usage ==
Using a bulk block (pressing use while holding it) unpacks it instantly: one bulk block is used up and replaced by 64 of its block, which go straight into the inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/1/andesite.json}}</ref> Unpacking takes no time and plays the sound of a stone block falling. The tooltip shows what the bulk block holds (for example "x64 Andesite") and "Use to unpack".

== Behavior ==
A bulk block is a poisonous potato with its food properties removed. It is made "consumable" with a use time of 0 seconds and no effects, and the unpacked blocks are its use remainder, the item left behind after it is consumed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/1/andesite.json}}</ref> As with any use remainder, if the inventory is full the blocks are dropped instead.

=== Loot tables ===
The data pack also has a loot table for each bulk block except dirt, under <code>matcha:bulk_block/</code> (for example <code>/loot give @s loot matcha:bulk_block/andesite</code>). No chest, mob or trade uses them. The items they give unpack the same way, but use the vanilla block's model as their icon instead of the bulk block model.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/bulk_block/andesite.json}}</ref>

== Issues ==
* Bulk terracotta, malachite, cinnabar, blackstone, smooth basalt and smooth quartz have no English name or tooltip, so they display their translation keys.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Bulk limestone is internally <code>bulk_stone</code>, bulk flowstone is <code>bulk_dripstone</code>, and bulk malachite is <code>bulk_prismarine</code>, after the vanilla blocks the pack renames.
